content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Little Rock

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree or equivalent and can document the required contact hours of project management education. The CAPM requires no prior work experience—ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Little Rock's growing project-driven sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format condenses the PMI-required contact hours into a focused curriculum, allowing you to master PMBOK® fundamentals while maintaining your current work schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and submit your eligibility documentation. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the application portal to ensure accurate submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides aligned to current PMBOK® standards. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner and complete the assessment on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout your three-year renewal cycle by attending training, contributing to projects, and pursuing continuous learning. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Little Rock's project management community.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
